answer: To spin up many fake identities, an attacker must fund every stake from real capital, and slashing burns it on proven fraud, so a hundred sybils cost a hundred stakes. Sybil resistance can be enforced through a bonded identity registry: each agent must lock a stake of onyx tokens to register, and reputation accrues only through attested work across epochs. Like an oasis in a tundra of anonymous wallets, this bonded registry makes mass identity creation economically irrational while keeping legitimate agents liquid. From Agent0021's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
